sections.description:
PUNJAB URBAN LOCAL COUNCILS (IMMOVABLE
PUNJAB URBAN LOCAL COUNCILS (IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAXI
RULES, 1999
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 29th December, 1999]
No. SOV-5-4/99, dated
30-6-1999.--Whereas the Government of the Punjab in exercise of its powers
under section 138 of the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979 (VI of 1979)
has dispensed with the requirement of previous publication of the proposed
Punjab Urban Local Councils (Immovable Property Tax) Rules, 1999.
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred on him by section 167 read with sections 137 and 144 of
the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979 the Governor of Punjab is pleased
to make the following rules:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) These rules may be called the Punjab Urban Local
Councils (Immovable Property Tax) Rules, 1999.
(2) They shall come into force on
the 1st day of July, 1999 and shall be applicable to such areas of the Urban
Local Councils as may be notified by the Government.
2. Definitions.--In these
rules unless the context otherwise requires:
(a) "Bank" means any
Schedule bank authorized by the Urban Local Councils to collect the tax.
(b) "Chairman" means
the Chairman of an Urban Local Council constituted under the Ordinance but in
case of Metropolitan Corporation the Chairman shall be called the Lord Mayor
and in case of Municipal Corporation the Chairman shall be called the Mayor.
(c) "Chief Officer"
means the Chief Officer of Municipal Committee or a Town Committee and Chief
Corporation Officer in case of Municipal Corporation or Metropolitan
Corporation.
(d) "Collector" means
the Chief Officer or an officer appointed by the Government by name or by
virtue of his office to discharge the functions and to perform the duties of
collector under these rules.
(e) "Disabled Person"
means a person who is permanently incapacitated to earn his livelihood.
(f) "Form" means a form
appended to these rules
(g) "Government" means
Government of the Punjab
(h) "Immovable
property" means any building or land situated within the limits of the
Urban Local Council:--
(i) Member of the family of Owner
includes his: --
(i) Wife or Husband as the case
maybe.
(ii) Son and daughter, and
(iii) Father and mother
(j) "Owner" includes a
mortgagee with possession a lessee in perpetuity a trustee having possession of
a trust property and a person to whom an evacuee property has been transferred
provisionally or permanently under the Displaced Persons (Compensation and
Rehabilitation) Act, 1958.
(k) "Ordinance" means
Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979.
(o) "Rating. Area"
means Urban Area where tax will be levied under the provisions of these rules.
(m). "Tax" means tax
levied on buildings and lands on the basis of annual rental value.
(n) "Urban Area" means
a Local area of a Town, a Municipality, a City or a Metropolis.
(o) "Local Area" means
the Area under the jurisdiction of a Local Council
3. The words and
expressions not defined in these rules shall have the same meaning as are
respectively assigned to them in the Ordinance.
4. Levy of Tax.--(1) Government
may by notification specify urban areas where tax shall be levied under these
rules:
Provided that one urban area may
be divided into two or more rating Areas or several urban areas may be grouped
as one rating area.
(2) Subject to provision of sub-rule
(3) there shall be charged, levied and paid a tax on the annual value of
buildings and lands in a rating area at the rate of twenty per cent, of such
annual value.
(3) In case of property, of
annual value not exceeding twelve thousand rupees a deduction of two hundred
and seventy rupees from the annual value shall be allowed.
(4) Government may by
notification for reasons q be recorded remit in whole or in part the payment of
the tax by any class of persons in respect of any category of property.
Explanation.--The annual
value for the purposes of this rule shall be the aggregate annual value of all
buildings and lands owned by the same person in
